construction_inventory.description: gescieppan create takes an accusative created entity; fixed divine creating sense.
Ordinary physical geseon/sēon seeing takes an accusative object. Content clauses remain supplied.
geswīcan ceases from an activity/work with genitive object, without a separately translated fram.
flēogan fly with wings has a subject and no required nominal object.
grōwan/weaxan grow describes the growing plant/tree; no nominal object in the selected frame.
scīnan shine in literal light-giving sense with a star/light subject.
swimman swim of a living creature, with no nominal object required.

eall ðā ðing means all those things. eall is strong neuter accusative plural, ðā demonstrative accusative plural, ðing neuter accusative plural. The whole phrase is supplied; eall remains recognition-only and no quantifier production is assigned.

weak_verb_boundary: gewyrcean make, gefyllan finish/accomplish, and geblētsian bless already have complete productive indicative systems and selected accusative frames in ch02. No new weak promotion is required by Exercise5.
